label: Exploratory patient-indicator extension after V5; not prospective external registration
known_results_before_extension: The published original and all V5 results were known. Four dashboard example rows had been observed, including Nov2021-Jan2022 n=24180 and Feb-Apr2025 n=17597. No full patient sequence or model had been analysed. These observations motivate, not confirm, this extension.
question: How do explicitly patient-based indicators for females aged 13-54 complement all-age/all-sex oral dispensing volume, and what measurement and population boundaries prevent substitution between them?
design: Descriptive complementary national aggregate series; no causal policy-effect estimate, independent-population validation, lifetime incident-use interpretation or dose-per-patient conversion.

endpoints.primary_descriptive: VPA1 numerator plus denominator-derived rate per1000, and VPA4 new-use indicator count if definitions/coverage verified
endpoints.supporting: VPA5 resumption count; VPA3 only as numerator cross-check if available; no subgroup mining
endpoints.windows: Primary descriptive snapshots are thirteen non-overlapping calendar quarters Q1 2022 through Q1 2025. All thirty-eight rolling windows ending March2022 through April2025 may be shown as contextual trajectories. February-April2025 is labelled as latest fully within-period window, overlapping Q1 2025 and not added as an independent quarter.
endpoints.period_boundary: Preserve primary dispensing January2022-April2025. Windows with constituent months outside that interval are excluded from analytic results; full source history may be retained for provenance/coverage only.
endpoints.comparisons: Absolute values and percent change Q1 2022 to Q1 2025 as calendar-matched descriptive endpoint comparison. Latest Feb-Apr2025 separately. Direction not selected after viewing. No inferential p-values, multiplicity search or ITS on this short quarterly series.

aggregation_rules: Do not sum overlapping patient windows or convert quarterly distinct-within-practice counts to monthly counts.
Do not sum starts and resumptions without independently verified mutual exclusivity; no derived discontinuation.
National counts may count one NHS number at multiple practices; label the actual indicator and disclose lack of national deduplication guarantee.
No division of all-age/all-sex oral DDD by female dashboard counts, no inference of dose/person or duration.

If displaying dispensing alongside patient series, align calendar windows but use separate axes/panels with explicit differing population/formulation coverage; no implied one-to-one conversion or causal effect comparison.

The linked2021 rules do not establish VPA4/VPA5 exclusivity: a prescription25-30 months before the current window could satisfy both24-month washout and6-month gap plus preceding24-month history. Keep both separate unless live definitions explicitly resolve this; do not derive continuing use by subtraction.
Thirteen non-overlapping time windows do not constitute thirteen independent patient cohorts; people may recur and time-series dependence remains. No independent-sample tests are planned.
qa: Verify source headers, national geography, female age13-54 filter and end-month labels; preserve raw export or full observed DOM text with honest provenance.
Verify unique complete monthly endpoint sequence; retain missing/suppressed symbols as missing, not zero; report coverage.
Check VPA1 rate=1000*numerator/denominator at published rounding tolerance and anchor rows against earlier observations.
Verify lookback definitions, formulation list and practice aggregation; distinguish currently linked2021 specification from confirmed live notes and unresolved historical version consistency.
Independently reconstruct quarter selection, descriptives and any matched dispensing-window aggregates from raw data; retain original models and V5 delivery hashes.
inclusion_gate: Include only retrieved, verified indicators that answer a distinct complementary question. If only VPA1 is complete, analyse that transparently without inventing VPA4/5. If critical definitions/coverage fail, retain an author-only feasibility record and do not add an effect claim.
pre_analysis_method_review: Independent review identified potential overlap between official new-use and resumption definitions before full series inspection; boundary strengthened without changing endpoint selection.
source: Official public NHSBSA dashboard, National, female age 13–54, VPA1. Public aggregates only; no individual records or credentials.
package_scope: Anonymous scientific amendment copy, with administrative instructions omitted. VPA4/VPA5 are not analysed or supplied as result series because live definitions conflict with the linked specification.
